home.description: A small playground for learning Next.js, React 19 and HeroUI. Clean, fast and ready for your next idea.

features.title: Fast by default
features.description: Server components stream HTML straight to the browser — no waiting on JS to render the page.

features.title: Composable UI
features.description: HeroUI gives you accessible, themeable components that play nicely with Tailwind v4.

features.title: Type-safe data
features.description: Drizzle ORM and Postgres are wired up, ready for real features when you need them.

about.title: About
about.body: This is a pet project for learning Next.js 16, React 19, and the modern frontend ecosystem. It explores server components, authentication, internationalization, and the App Router. Built with HeroUI, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL.
